         AGAVE AMERICANA

       Century Plant


Indicated in stomachache, and painful erections in gonorrhœa. Strangury.
      Hydrophobia. Scurvy; countenance pale, gums swollen and bleeding, legs covered with dark
      purple blotches, swollen, painful and hard. Appetite poor; bowels constipated.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Anhalonium;
      Lyssin; Lach  .



Dose.--  Tincture
